name: Click Indicators
description: Shows you the exact frame to click, using macros from players who already beat the level.

enabled.name: Show guide
enabled.description: Master toggle for the whole overlay.

safe-mode.name: Safe mode
safe-mode.description: Nothing you do counts while the guide is actually running: no best percentage, no completion, no stars, orbs, diamonds or coins, no attempt counter, and nothing sent to the leaderboard. On a level with no macro downloaded there is no guide, so this does nothing and your runs count as normal. Turning it off mid-attempt does not restore that attempt - restart the level for a run that counts.

free-camera.name: Free camera when paused
free-camera.description: Desktop only, it needs a keyboard. Pause the game and pan around the level with the arrow keys or WASD to scout what is coming. The camera snaps back to where it was the moment you resume, so it cannot affect the run.

auto-fetch.name: Auto-fetch macros online
auto-fetch.description: When you enter a level with no downloaded macros, download some from hyperbolus.net automatically. Otherwise use the download button on the level screen.

record-button.name: Record button in pause menu
record-button.description: Adds a Record / Stop button to the pause screen so you can capture your own run and save it as a guide. Frames are speed-independent, so you can slow the game right down, play through, and the saved macro still lines up at full speed.

ticks.name: Press sound
ticks.description: Play a sharp click at each press (pitch rises for tighter windows).

release-sound.name: Release sound
release-sound.description: Play a distinct softer down-tone when a hold should be released.

tight-pitch.name: Pitch by window tightness
tight-pitch.description: Raise the press pitch on frame-perfect clicks so you can hear how precise to be.

sound-pack.name: Cue sounds
sound-pack.description: Click = the original sharp chirp. Beep = clean studio blip. Wood = dry woodblock, easiest to keep a rhythm to. Snap = unpitched noise, never clashes with the song.

indicator-mode.name: Indicator style
indicator-mode.description: Ring = a ring collapses onto your icon, the most precise and the best default. Classic = the scrolling line and window, the only style that shows you how wide the timing window is. Converge = two lines slide in and meet on you, without covering your icon. Pulse = just the reticle brightening, for when you want almost nothing on screen. Highway = a Guitar Hero style lane in the corner: notes fall toward a bar and you press as each one lands, with holds drawn as long notes. It is the only style that shows several upcoming clicks and their rhythm at once. All of them turn bright green the instant you are on target.

hw-x.name: Highway: across
hw-x.description: Where the lane sits from left to right, as a fraction of the screen. 0 = hard left, 1 = hard right. Only used by the Highway style.
hw-x.enable-if-description: Set <cy>Indicator style</c> to <cj>Highway</c> to use this.

hw-y.name: Highway: height
hw-y.description: Where the bottom of the lane sits, as a fraction of the screen height. Raise it if the lane runs off the top, lower it to keep it out of the way. Only used by the Highway style.
hw-y.enable-if-description: Set <cy>Indicator style</c> to <cj>Highway</c> to use this.

hw-scale.name: Highway: size
hw-scale.description: Overall size of the lane. 1 = the standard size, 0.5 = half, 2 = double. Width and height scale together so the notes keep their shape. Only used by the Highway style.
hw-scale.enable-if-description: Set <cy>Indicator style</c> to <cj>Highway</c> to use this.

hw-opacity.name: Highway: opacity
hw-opacity.description: How solid the lane, its notes and its hit bar are. Separate from the main Indicator opacity, because the lane sits over the level's artwork in the corner while the guide lines sit on the gameplay itself. 1 = solid.
hw-opacity.enable-if-description: Set <cy>Indicator style</c> to <cj>Highway</c> to use this.

hw-guides.name: Highway: lane lines
hw-guides.description: The two rails down the sides of the lane and the faint half-second lines across it. Turn this off for just the notes and the hit bar on a bare lane. The notes, the arrows and the bar itself are never hidden.
hw-guides.enable-if-description: Set <cy>Indicator style</c> to <cj>Highway</c> to use this.

ring.name: Show timing cue
ring.description: Draw the selected Indicator style marker for the next click. Off = just the reticle (plus the Classic guide lines).

hold-bar.name: Hold bar
hold-bar.description: The bar drawn from a press to its release, showing how long to keep holding. Turn it off for taps only. Also hidden by "Guide lines in Classic only" outside the Classic style.

notches.name: Countdown notches
notches.description: Pre-roll ticks 150/100/50 ms before the press (full-speed only).

lines-classic-only.name: Guide lines in Classic only
lines-classic-only.description: Hides the scrolling window bars, the target line and the hold bar in the Ring, Converge and Pulse styles, leaving just the cue itself. Classic is unaffected.

hide-from.name: Hide guide from (%)
hide-from.description: Start of a stretch of the level where the guide is turned off, so you can practise that part unaided while the rest of the level still shows. Set this and "Hide guide to" to the same value to disable it. Ignored in platformer levels, where a percentage has no meaning.

hide-to.name: Hide guide to (%)
hide-to.description: End of the hidden stretch. To practise the opening of a level with no help, set "from" to 0 and this to 20. To blank out a section in the middle, set 20 and 50.

indicator-opacity.name: Indicator opacity
indicator-opacity.description: How solid the indicators drawn on the level are - the press line, the hold bar, the guide lines and the stats readout. The Highway lane has its own setting. 1 = solid, lower = fainter.

smooth-lines.name: Smooth lines
smooth-lines.description: Antialiases everything the mod draws, so edges look clean instead of stair-stepped. Turn this off if the overlay looks wrong on your graphics card. Takes effect next time you enter a level.

cue-contrast.name: Contrast
cue-contrast.description: Lays a dark halo under the cue and guide lines so they stay readable on bright, busy levels instead of blending into the level's own artwork. 0 = a thin outline only, 1 = heavy separation.

reduce-flashing.name: Reduce flashing
reduce-flashing.description: Cap the brightness of the ignition / press flashes.

feedback.name: Trainer feedback + HUD
feedback.description: Show how many frames early/late each click was, plus an accuracy/streak/calibration HUD.

release-grading.name: Grade releases too
release-grading.description: Also judge when you let go of a hold, not just when you press. In ship, UFO, wave, robot and swing the hold length IS the input, so a perfect press with a wrong release still kills you - this is what tells you that happened. Off by default: it is one more line on screen.

stats-hud.name: Stats readout
stats-hud.description: Show accuracy, streak and calibration figures in the corner of the screen. Off by default - it is mostly useful while tuning your timing.

debug-logging.name: Debug logging
debug-logging.description: Write detailed diagnostics for macro loading, recording and licensing to the Geode log. Turn this on before reporting a problem.

lead.name: Cue lead (seconds)
lead.description: Shifts every cue this far earlier, to cover the gap between the game drawing a frame and your click reaching it. 0 puts the cue exactly on the macro's timing. Raise it a little if you keep pressing late.
